title: Resolving the Hubble Tension in the Early Dark Energy Framework with JWST and DESI Data (Du, Li, Yin, Zhou, Wang, Zhang, Zhang)
efc_relevance: Canonical axion EDE fit to CMB (Planck + ACT + SPT) + DESI BAO + JWST UV luminosity functions gives H0 = 71.58 ± 1.05 km/s/Mpc, reducing the SH0ES tension to ~1.0σ with a significantly better fit than ΛCDM. Sharpens the H0-three-window competitor field for EFC's P7 prediction and directly updates framework:EDE-Poulin2019 with a JWST-anchored posterior; provides the empirical bar EFC's L0/L1-regime H0 mechanism must match.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as H0-three-window competitor anchor (JWST-anchored EDE branch); update framework:EDE-Poulin2019 row with the CMB+DESI+JWST H0 posterior; cross-reference arXiv:2606.06495 (recombination modifications) and arXiv:2606.17550 (DHO DE); promote pending_review_2026_05_01 h0_three_window cluster.
